name: Cataclysmic Power raises Flare Bolt per periodic effect (#1040)
contract: #1040: Cataclysmic Power 804617 / 807882 / 807912 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) on SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (misc 12), base 2 / 5 / 8 -> +3 / +6 / +9, class mask {0x200, 0x100, 0x41000000} = Blaze, Ignite, Scorched, Infernus (Spell.dbc served file). Tooltip: increases the damage of Flare Bolt by $s1% for each periodic effect you have on the target. The DBC carrier is each DoT's second effect (aura 271 MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, base -1 -> 0, mask {0, 2, 0} = Flare Bolt), which the module overwrites with dummy bookkeeping, so the bonus never existed. The fix multiplies Flare Bolt's damage taken by (1 + rank%) for each of the caster's Blaze 805500, Ignite 800791, Scorched 680962 and Infernus 706874 on the target, the way the native 271 auras would stack (multiplicatively; a two-DoT bound accepts the additive and the compounded reading since the tooltip does not say). script_spell_damage_taken runs the module damage-taken hooks on a base of 1000 with the actor as the damaged unit and target as the attacker; the fixture applies the DoT auras to the caster itself with set_aura (caster and target are the same player, so the auras are owned by the caster). Fails before the fix (always 1000). Float rounding of 1.03 x 1000 allows a 1029..1031 bound.

steps.label: Flare Bolt is unchanged with no periodic effect and no talent
Ignite is on the caster's own target (fixture: the caster)
One DoT without the talent leaves Flare Bolt unchanged
Rank 1: one DoT adds 3% to Flare Bolt
Rank 1: a spell outside Flare Bolt is unchanged
Rank 2: one DoT adds 6% to Flare Bolt
Rank 3: one DoT adds 9% to Flare Bolt
Rank 3: two DoTs add 9% each (additive 18%, compounded 18.81%)
Rank 3: with no DoT Flare Bolt is unchanged again
